tools.name: get_page_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a geoSurge page by site-relative path and return its content as Markdown.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List geoSurge's published blog articles with titles, URLs, dates, and summaries.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate the current browser tab to a geoSurge page by site-relative path (home, pricing, blog, contact, an article, …).

tools.name: search_geosurge
tools.description: Search geoSurge's blog and content for a query. Returns matching articles as Markdown links with summaries.
